title: Which edition do you need, UK or American?
alt: Printed copies of The Don't Die Retired Christmas Puzzle Book and the UK and American editions of the Christmas Quiz Book on a wooden table, beside the words: Which edition do you need, UK or American?

posts.facebook:
Most of the rounds in our Christmas Quiz Book are in both editions. The UK edition adds rounds such as Kings and queens and Panto and the stage; the American edition has Presidents and The fifty states. Each says its edition on the front and the spine.
